text:
ash: FYI found a reproducible RoPE phase "bleed" when bringing up the new int4 quantized build on very long contexts (~130k tokens). generation is fine until a sudden semantically unrelated token appears, then drift continues.

ravi: wow 130k, are you using our rescaled RoPE codepath or legacy?

ash: rescaled. float32 and float16 no repro. int4 and int8 show divergence starting around token 129371. toggling kv_tile_size moves the onset a bit.

sarah: can you share the minimal run command and a tiny log excerpt?

ash: repro command below. kept tiny for this thread.

```
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-13b-int4-qkv","input":"<130k-prompt>"}' > out.json
jq .out[129360:129380] out.json
```
log snippet:
```
[2026-05-01T09:12:03Z] INFO decode token=129369 pos_phase=0.9987
[2026-05-01T09:12:04Z] INFO decode token=129370 pos_phase=0.9987
[2026-05-01T09:12:05Z] INFO decode token=129371 pos_phase=0.4371  # abrupt jump
```

ravi: pos_phase jump suggests RoPE phase table indexing wrapped or scaled incorrectly under quant kernel. maybe the phase table was stored in reduced precision and the stride computation got rounded.

sarah: did we change the way we compress position embeddings for int4 pipeline? there was a PR that packs phase floats into int16 halves.

ash: yes that packing is only applied for quant pipelines. i ran with unpacking enabled and the repro disappears. so packing + rescale math combo seems to lose precision at very large offsets.

ci-bot: build 2026.05.01-quantpack completed (branch quant/pack-phase)  tests: 206 passed, 8 flaky (longctx).

ravi: proposed fix: use a compensated accumulator when computing pos_phase for packed tables (Kahan-style) or prevent packing when MAX_CTX > 1<<16. also add a nightly longctx-quant test that runs to 150k tokens.

sarah: agree. adding metric `rope_phase_jump_total` and alert if rate > 0.5/hour/node. also add unit test for packed/unpacked equivalence over big offsets.

ash: opening PR with guarded pack disable + unit tests + perf numbers. perf hit for disabling pack is small (~1.2%) on short runs but negligible on long runs due to memory bandwidth dominated path. PR will also include repro script and logs.

ravi: thanks ash. once CI green let's run a 72h staging with int4/qkv and long prompts. if stable, backport to stable-2026.04.

sarah: ping me on the PR for test design.

ash: will do. thanks all :thumbsup:
